title: Maximum total building height
text: C3.2.1 Building height complies with Table 3.2a. Table 3.2a Maximum building heights, maximum total building height: R2-R35 10m; R40-R60 13m; R80, R100, R160 and LR, MR and HR 16m. Refer Figure 3.2a for building height and natural ground level measurement guidance. Refer Figure 3.2b for total building height guidance. This table provides a maximum building height only and development will need to consider other elements such as 3.9 Solar access for adjoining sites.

replaces.note: 7 m wall limit removed; skillion/gable/concealed 8 m -> 10 m

source.file: Residential Design Codes Chapter 2 - Single Houses.pdf

notes: Height is the highest point of the development above natural ground level (deemed natural ground level where it varies). No wall height or roof-type limits in the draft. R100-SL 16 m taken from Table 2A (p7).

verified.note: Values match p28. R100-SL 16 m is not in Table 3.2a but Table 2A (p7) prints 16m spanning R80 and R100-SL, and Table 2.10a (p25) refers R100-SL to Table 3.2a.
